_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::cardiac_monodomain#1. The upstream Cardiac_Monodomain decks are single elements, so the fixture builds a propagating wave: a HEX8 strip of length 0.4 with the same MAT_myocard FHN material and DIFF 1.171e-4 as scatra_myocard_FHN_material, excited over the first 8% and integrated to t=80 at dt=0.1. Front position is interpolated from 4C's own result-test 'actresult=' lines, one probe per node. h=0.005 puts the front at 0.19586; h=0.04, eight times coarser, at 0.14005 -- net of the 0.032 excited region a conduction velocity 34% too low, inside the claimed 10-30% band and slightly past it. MESH_RESOLUTION_WARNINGS=0. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: give the coarse arm the fine mesh. Both fronts land on the same place, the velocity error goes to 0 and the fixture must go red.
